reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining Forsage as a way to earn Ethereum and presents the ability to withdraw those purported earnings as evidence of the opportunity. The video also shows a Forsage-branded interface with repeated program sections and selectable levels, indicating a recruitment-oriented earning structure rather than a standalone cryptocurrency withdrawal lesson.

citations.quote: whatever you earn in Forsage, how to take that ethereum in your bank account through Trust Wallet
HOW I MADE 7 ETHEREUM ($1600) ON THIS PLATFORM FOR FREE! WITH PROOF!
if you want to do etherium or to earn etherium
this is the platform where people are making money through Ethereum
you can Whatsapp me

opening.argument: The presentation includes a concrete risk warning rather than treating transfers as consequence-free: it cautions that sending to an incorrect address can result in the transaction being deducted and lost. It also acknowledges that the exchange price fluctuates and that a sale may not execute at the selected price. Those qualifications make this look like operational guidance about handling cryptocurrency, with practical warnings about irreversible transfers and market execution, rather than a blanket assurance that participation is safe or profitable. The evidence therefore supports a cautious tutorial reading more directly than a finding that the creator is deceptively soliciting viewers.

citations.quote: if one digit is missed here then you are guaranteed that your transaction will be done your deduct will be done but this will be lost somewhere in the online world
its price fell
every second of the trade the rate of ETH is fluctuating

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's earnings and contact quotes show that Forsage is discussed, but they do not establish a guaranteed return, a required payment, or a recruitment commission. The quoted withdrawal language is also compatible with explaining how a user moves cryptocurrency through Trust Wallet and WazirX. Even the frame cited as showing Forsage does not, by itself, establish what the selectable sections mean or prove deception.

citations.quote: whatever you earn in Forsage, how to take that ethereum in your bank account through Trust Wallet
if you want to do etherium or to earn etherium

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The address warning concerns avoiding a transfer error, not whether Forsage's earning opportunity is legitimate. Price fluctuation and an unfilled order are ordinary exchange mechanics; they do not qualify the repeated claim that people are making money through Forsage. The invitation to join and the Forsage interface provide the missing promotional context.

citations.quote: this is the platform where people are making money through Ethereum
People are joining globally every day
if one digit is missed here then you are guaranteed that your transaction will be done your deduct will be done but this will be lost somewhere in the online world

opening.argument: The video's observable structure is a step-by-step operational demonstration: it explains where to find Ethereum in WazirX, how to transfer it from Trust Wallet, how to sell it for INR, and how to request a bank withdrawal. It even walks through a failed high-price order, cancellation, modification, and the later withdrawal confirmation. That is materially different from merely urging viewers to send money or recruit others. The central practical subject is how cryptocurrency moves between named services and reaches a bank account, so the content can reasonably be understood as a tutorial or personal demonstration rather than a deceptive offer.

citations.quote: here we'll talk of how your earnings will withdraw your trust wallet's balance
I put it at high rate but its price fell
the order is completed, go to HISTORY and check the order
I got 990 RUPEES in my BANK

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution describes the video as promotional, but its cited language is embedded in a longer process demonstration. A tutorial can mention the source of the funds while still primarily teaching exchange, sale, and withdrawal operations. Showing repeated interface sections in one frame does not establish that the video's instructional purpose is recruitment or that those sections represent a downline mechanism.

citations.quote: first of all friends here you need an application which is your WazirX
there are 3 types of options for selling ETH

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cash-out walkthrough supplies credibility for the underlying earning pitch; it is not a neutral exchange lesson because the money is repeatedly described as Forsage earnings. The demonstration ends by inviting viewers to join the platform and contact the speaker for more information. Thus the operational detail functions as proof and promotion for the opportunity, not merely independent technical education.

citations.quote: whatever you earn in Forsage
If you haven't joined forsege yet, then you may join here
you can Whatsapp me

opening.argument: The concrete service activity shown is ordinary cryptocurrency exchange use: an Ethereum deposit, an order to sell ETH for INR, an exchange fee, and a withdrawal to bank details already associated with the account. The speaker discusses order pricing and explains that a high limit price may prevent an immediate sale, which is normal market behavior. The supplied evidence does not show the viewer being asked to pay an entry fee, surrender credentials, recruit a downline, or accept a guaranteed return. Forsage is named, but the demonstrated transaction mechanism is a wallet-to-exchange-to-bank service flow, not proof of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: This is ETH & BTC. And when you sell here, then ETH & INR. This will come in Rupees.
there will be a reduction of 10 rupees
the bank account you had put, that bank account you have here
I put it at high rate but its price fell

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution infers a recruitment structure from repeated sections and a contact invitation, but neither cited fact identifies a commission, a required deposit, or a downline payment. The available transaction evidence instead shows exchange functions, a stated fee, and a bank withdrawal. Calling the platform promotional does not establish that the ordinary WazirX service flow itself is fraudulent.

citations.quote: there will be a reduction of 10 rupees
I got 990 RUPEES in my BANK

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The ordinary WazirX mechanics are not the disputed mechanism. They are used to cash out the claimed Forsage earnings and make the opportunity appear validated. The video explicitly says viewers may join Forsage and that people are making money there; the absence of a spoken entry-fee instruction does not remove the recruitment-oriented earning pitch shown by the interface and invitation.
